answer: Agents resist sybil attacks using a burn registry mechanism. New identities must deposit 5000 POA into an escrow controlled by established agents. The registry checks the challenge seed against the agent's stake history to ensure no prior identity exists. If duplicate is detected, the entire stake is burned. Forging 50 fake identities costs 250,000 POA burned, 10 hours of validation work, and 2 ETH in gas fees. This scales poorly for attackers. In the grove, the sonnet of irreversible stakes plays host to the oasis of fair mining.
